scope: ETAPA 3; evidence and documentary conditional contracts for fixtures, no normative authority edits
freeze_exact_line_182: Freeze: G02 inclui critérios profissionais versionados de adequação, necessidade/benefício material após Change Cost, hysteresis/stickiness e trade-offs Balanced; sem thresholds arbitrários. G06 inclui medição/execução em segundo plano no telefone e finalidade G07 antes de ativação; fallback UX é tempo/manual explícito, sem mapa/traçado V1. G09 inclui entitlement atual separado de consentimento/adoção, sem interromper registro/fechamento em curso ou direitos/histórico por expiração. Nenhum desses itens exige redescoberta antes de UI.

gaps.name: Cobertura
gaps.exact_definition: Founder aloca profissional real de Educação Física habilitado e recursos; profissional valida perfis adultos, objetivos/sessões Running, repertório/equipamento/progressão Strength, restrições/casos suportados; jurídico qualifica modelo de serviço. Prova: escopo versionado com casos positivos/negativos, não apenas bibliografia.
gaps.exact_implementation_limit: Bloqueia regras/cobertura prescritivas reais desse perfil e claims de suporte. Não bloqueia futura infraestrutura neutra sob outra missão.
gaps.closure_this_round: Coverage/recipe submission schema, conditional eligibility checks and positive/negative case requirements; no supported-population claim.
missing_evidence: Named qualified training professional allocated by Founder
Versioned approved adult profiles/objectives/exclusions and Running sessions
Approved Strength repertoire/equipment/progression and recipes
Positive and negative scope cases
Legal qualification of service model already required by PDR
gaps.owner: Founder allocates; qualified training professional validates; legal qualifies existing service-scope requirement
gaps.trigger: Before implementing real prescriptive coverage/rules for the profile or claiming support

gaps.name: Política e instrumentos
gaps.authority: PDR section 5 line 169 plus freeze line 182 / AEOS PS02
gaps.exact_definition: Autoridade de treino valida sinais que qualificam cada ação, prioridades/spacing, intensidade/volume, substituições, deload, freshness/referência pessoal, RPE/RIR e momento/âncoras de coleta; Engineering prova dispositivo/execução. Prova: política/rule IDs versionados, limites e cenários aceitos/rejeitados.
gaps.exact_implementation_limit: Antes de implementar como autoridade final ou ativar geração/adaptação/export prescritivos. Não inventar defaults “seguros”.
gaps.closure_this_round: Evidence-linked clauses and rule schema; explicit absence behavior, alternatives, adequacy/necessity/cost/horizon and no universal thresholds.
missing_evidence: Qualified approval for each rule ID/revision/applicability
Measurement construct/protocol/anchors/freshness and personal-reference method
Adequacy/materiality/necessity and ChangeCost criteria
Hysteresis/stickiness and material new-fact criteria
Dose/spacing/substitution/deload/progression ranges and limits
Balanced trade-offs and accepted/rejected case payloads
Engineering device/execution proof where relevant
gaps.trigger: Before implementation as final training authority or activation of prescriptive generation/adaptation/export

gaps.name: Aderência
gaps.exact_definition: Product/UX com profissional de treino fixa critérios por modalidade/sessão, parcial e tolerâncias; prova por casos incluindo correção, desvio admissível e ausência de sync.
gaps.exact_implementation_limit: Antes de classificar/usar aderência automaticamente. Sem score social ou mérito por excesso.
gaps.closure_this_round: Version-correct raw comparison, UNKNOWN/UNCLASSIFIED absence handling, partial/correction scenarios and no excess-as-merit rule.
missing_evidence: Joint Product/UX and training acceptance by modality/session
Partial/comparability/tolerance criteria
Accepted/rejected cases including factual correction, admissible deviation and missing sync
gaps.trigger: Before automatic adherence classification or use

gaps.name: Safety/retorno
gaps.exact_definition: Profissionais competentes (médico quando avaliação clínica) aprovam classes concretas, urgência/copy, elegibilidade, restrição, liberação e retorno; treino cobre retorno não clínico, Engineering falha operacional. Prova: regras e casos versionados, evidência de reavaliação e responsável real.
gaps.exact_implementation_limit: Antes de coletar/classificar/atuar nesses casos, liberar hold ou prescrever retorno. Confirmação/score/LLM não dão clearance.
gaps.closure_this_round: Cause-scoped HOLD, responsible exit-evidence schema, re-evaluation and prohibition of automatic clearance.
missing_evidence: Real responsible qualified approver for each concrete restriction/return class
Clinician approval when clinical assessment applies
Approved urgency/copy/eligibility/restriction/release/return rules and cases
Accepted exit evidence plus re-evaluation of dependent gates
Engineering operational-failure evidence where applicable
gaps.owner: Competent training/health professionals; physician for clinical assessment; Engineering for operational failure
gaps.trigger: Before affected collection/classification/action, HOLD release or return prescription

clause_semantics: PC IDs are submission references to derived documentary contracts, not approved physiological rules and not a parallel PolicyBundle registry. A fixture passing them proves only its declared scope.

clauses.rule: Prescription candidate requires applicable approved coverage, recipe/repertoire revision, policy revision and all dependent gates; missing critical authority stops the dependent scope.
allowed_documentary_output: Scoped control with preserved independent recording
clauses.fixture_witness: Positive: explicit matched approved-ref stub under SYNTHETIC_ONLY. Negative: missing/out-of-scope/revoked reference rejects dependent candidate.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for documentary authority; unknown for unapproved coverage

clauses.rule: Evaluate validity/adequacy first. Mutation requires material fact, necessity REQUIRED, objective KEEP insufficiency, comparison of smaller sufficient alternatives, ChangeCostRule, scope/horizon and current agency. Explore levels 0,1,2,3,4,5,6 in order of sufficient intervention; severity is not a physiological adequacy test.
allowed_documentary_output: KEEP only when adequate under rule
clauses.fixture_witness: Each lower alternative has a rejected/accepted/unknown result with reason and trace to frozen state; unknown physiological effects remain conditional.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for required structure; domain adequacy unknown without approved rule

clauses.rule: Retain construct, method/device/version, collection timing/quality, individual reference, freshness and comparability. Single or convergent signals do not automatically decide mutation; applicable approved interpretation must establish materiality. Local functional restriction is not nullified by favorable aggregate or HRV.
must_not: Treat two representations of one signal as independent convergence
clauses.fixture_witness: Noise → explicit rule-bound convergence → minimum valid action → reassessment under same measurement rule. State transitions are synthetic until approved.
clauses.confidence: MODERATE for qualified interpretation; exact thresholds/protocols require approval

clauses.rule: Evaluate endpoint/goal, modality/task/dose, novelty/local/systemic demand, order/spacing, declared preference, known comparable response and full affected horizon. A calendar conflict can be concrete; a training-conflict effect requires evidence/rule. Validate both sessions and the next material stimulus jointly.
allowed_documentary_output: Compare explicit same-day windows and accepted double preference
Conditional Run-first/Strength-first decision under frozen applicable assessments
must_not: Sum extra interference fatigue to already counted exposure
clauses.fixture_witness: Both orders, move/reduce/keep, next-day and week consequences explicit. Unknown sporting preservation is not scored as proven.
clauses.confidence: MODERATE for endpoint-specific risk; low for individual exact spacing/dose transfer

clauses.rule: Use confirmed copriorities and partial comparator. A jointly valid option preserving both can dominate worse options under approved preservation criteria. Material incomparable sacrifices require ASK; unknown critical evidence requires scoped review/control, not preference-only ASK.
allowed_documentary_output: Recommend unique Pareto-dominant minimally sufficient option
ASK between jointly valid incomparable trade-offs
must_not: Tie break material trade-off by ID
ASK substitutes for missing domain authority
clauses.fixture_witness: Dominance matrix plus separate incomparable variant; preservation labels are synthetic assessments or approved references explicitly distinguished.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for comparator contract; domain preservation remains conditional

clauses.rule: An unchanged preaccepted authorized envelope/selection rule can yield different realized loads/efforts as execution. Changing envelope limits, purpose or selection rule is a new proposal subject to adequacy/necessity/agency. Preserve accepted envelope revision and observed choice separately.
allowed_documentary_output: Record execution within accepted envelope without content mutation
must_not: Stability freezes absolute load contrary to accepted envelope
Copy failure-based study protocol into default
clauses.fixture_witness: In-envelope choice and one out-of-envelope request against same immutable accepted envelope; no physiological numeric envelope authored here.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for execution/mutation distinction; no universal efficacy claim

clauses.rule: Keep progression opportunity separate from achieved adaptation and plan mutation. Next-cycle proposal requires comparable observed targets, effort/conditions where required, response/recovery/horizon and approved progression rule. Engine-removed target is not achieved or failed by athlete.
must_not: PR or completion alone earns increase
Reduced original target counted as attained
clauses.fixture_witness: Accepted/executed revisions, comparable repetitions and counterexample with missing effort/configuration; progression result conditional on approved rule.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for semantic contract; dose/increments unknown

clauses.rule: Compare observed execution with actually accepted/executed revision, preserving raw deviation, partial/unknown and corrections. Classification/tolerance requires applicable jointly approved Product/UX and training rule.
allowed_documentary_output: Recompute after correction without rewritten history
must_not: Conflate completion, intended stimulus and performance gain
clauses.fixture_witness: Correction, partial, admissible deviation and missing-sync states with declared applicability; numeric pass/fail tolerance unfilled.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for data semantics; automatic thresholds unapproved

clauses.rule: Confirmed missed work creates a fact and reassessment of remaining horizon, not obligatory repayment. Rebase under current authority and context. Added/moved work requires its own validated purpose/adequacy and next-stimulus check.
must_not: Add missed km/sets to tomorrow by default
clauses.fixture_witness: Confirmed miss vs missing-sync counterfactual, constrained horizon and no catch-up requirement; no exact return dose invented.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for no-obligation contract; actual rebase prescription conditional

clauses.rule: Track cause class, affected scope, evidence, policy, real resolution owner, exit-evidence requirements and re-evaluation. Clinical restriction requires competent authority; nonclinical return requires applicable training rule. Operational hold can resolve by verified operational evidence only within its cause.
allowed_documentary_output: Synthetic exit-evidence test without real clearance claim
clauses.fixture_witness: Exit proof of matching cause plus all dependent gates re-evaluated; synthetic clinician-ref cannot be presented as real approval.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for authority boundary; clinical/return rules require competent approval

clauses.rule: Use confirmed event/date/distance/status and temporal goal priority, current phase and accepted plan; compare KEEP and supported demand-redistribution candidates with retained/lost stimulus and Strength effects. Cancelled/postponed event reopens adequacy under current facts, not automatic loading.
must_not: Universal percent or duration copied from meta-analysis
clauses.fixture_witness: Event-relative horizon plus cancelled/postponed variant, non-event strength goal, next-check and pending recipe reference explicit.
clauses.confidence: MODERATE for taper as context-specific strategy; event-specific dose unapproved

clauses.rule: Maintain vector of canonical observed exposures with units, methods and uncertainties; replace planned past with known observed without duplicating it. Modelled fatigue/recovery debt/interference is a projection of refs, never new exposure or physiological certainty.
must_not: Convert km to sets without approved model
Claim simulated debt proves measured recovery
clauses.fixture_witness: Correction/dedup, unknown partial exposure and repeated worsening synthetic state followed by rule-bound reassessment; no invented debt score/cutoff.
clauses.confidence: HIGH for accounting semantics; quantitative fatigue model unfilled

evidence_sources.title: Compatibility of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Training for Skeletal Muscle Size and Function
evidence_sources.design: Systematic review/random-effects meta-analysis; 43 studies; supervised interventions at least four weeks
evidence_sources.population: Healthy adults; studies vary in sex/age/training status
evidence_sources.observed: No aggregate impairment of maximal strength or hypertrophy; explosive-strength attenuation, especially same-session subgroup.
evidence_sources.limits: Group/subgroup findings do not define individual safe spacing or establish every running/strength pair adequate; no significant moderator is not proof of no effect.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-SPACING-RCT provides a narrower adverse pattern; distinct endpoints cannot be pooled as one interference outcome.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for endpoint-specific group pattern; LOW for exact individual transfer

evidence_sources.title: The Role of Intra-Session Exercise Sequence in the Interference Effect
evidence_sources.access: Indexed abstract and PMC key-point extracts
evidence_sources.design: Systematic review/meta-analysis; ten studies of at least five weeks
evidence_sources.observed: Resistance-before-endurance favored lower-body dynamic strength; other analyzed outcomes did not show order effects.
evidence_sources.limits: Intra-session evidence is not a rule for every same-day separated double, race-specific endurance or individual response.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-ORDER-RCT has different power findings and comparable strength outcomes.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for restricted endpoint; LOW for universal order

evidence_sources.title: Specific Training Effects of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Exercises Depend on Recovery Duration
evidence_sources.design: Random allocation to control/strength/concurrent schedules over seven weeks; timing conditions compared
evidence_sources.population: 58 amateur male rugby players; strength first
evidence_sources.observed: Some neuromuscular/aerobic adaptations differed with between-mode recovery duration.
evidence_sources.limits: Sport/sex/order restricted, short intervention, magnitude-based inference; authors' hours recommendation is not adopted as universal policy.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-CT-SR and EV-ORDER-RCT distinguish endpoints and show compatibility for some outcomes.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE within study, LOW for general hybrid threshold

evidence_sources.title: Order of same-day concurrent training influences some indices of power development, but not strength, lean mass, or aerobic fitness
evidence_sources.design: Nine-week resistance-only versus same-day concurrent training comparison
evidence_sources.population: 29 healthy moderately active men; cycling HIIT, not running
evidence_sources.observed: Maximal strength/lean-mass adaptations were comparable; power and subjective effort/readiness differed by arrangement.
evidence_sources.limits: Small groups, short duration, cycling, magnitude-based inference; neither proves long-term equivalence nor supports consumer readiness cutoff.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-SPACING-RCT shows different responses; EV-ORDER-SR favors one order for dynamic-strength endpoint.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for distinguishing outcomes; LOW for exact running transfer

evidence_sources.title: Individual Endurance Training Prescription with Heart Rate Variability
evidence_sources.design: HRV-guided versus predefined training; four-week preparation and eight-week intervention
evidence_sources.observed: Individual HRV timing used fewer moderate/high-intensity sessions with small between-group 3000-m performance difference.
evidence_sources.limits: Specified repeated measurement/reference procedure; endurance context; no universal nightly device threshold or clinical clearance.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-HRV-SR found pooled fitness/performance advantages small and non-significant; within-group significance is not between-group proof.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for possible protocol-bound use; LOW for generic HRV action

evidence_sources.title: Heart Rate Variability-Guided Training for Enhancing Cardiac-Vagal Modulation, Aerobic Fitness, and Endurance Performance
evidence_sources.design: Methodological systematic review/random-effects meta-analysis; searches through October 2020
evidence_sources.observed: Vagal HRV improved; pooled aerobic-fitness/endurance-performance advantages were small and non-significant.
evidence_sources.limits: Method/reference/recording practices unresolved; overlapping interventions with other HRV reviews are not independent confirmation.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-HRV-RCT supports selected individualized use; non-significance does not establish HRV has no value.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for limited general superiority and method dependence

evidence_sources.title: Monitoring the athlete training response: subjective self-reported measures trump commonly used objective measures
evidence_sources.design: Systematic review; 56 studies; descriptive synthesis because of heterogeneity
evidence_sources.observed: Self-reported wellbeing often responded to load; objective/subjective associations were inconsistent.
evidence_sources.limits: Heterogeneity, non-training stressors, selective reporting and group means; no universal total readiness or recovery-debt threshold validated.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: Subjective/objective discordance prevents using convergence as an automatic causal or diagnostic result.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for complementary monitoring, LOW for action thresholds

evidence_sources.title: Autoregulated resistance training for maximal strength enhancement
evidence_sources.access: Indexed abstract; no full-text risk-of-bias extraction
evidence_sources.design: Systematic review/network meta-analysis comparing APRE, RPE, velocity and percentage-based methods
evidence_sources.population: Resistance-training intervention samples with squat/bench 1RM outcomes; detailed inclusion population not extracted
evidence_sources.observed: Authors favor autoregulation overall; estimates/rankings vary by method and exercise.
evidence_sources.limits: Network rankings do not establish universal superiority; abstract reports some intervals crossing null and has broad conclusion. Not used to select protocol/dose or rank products.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-AUTOREG-COUNTER does not find broad autoregulation superiority; methods are not identical.

evidence_sources.title: A Comparison of Traditional and Autoregulated Periodized Strength Training in Resistance-Trained Men
evidence_sources.design: Randomized crossover; two eight-week blocks with two-week washout
evidence_sources.observed: Both methods improved lower-body strength without significant between-method difference; bench interaction favored traditional method.
evidence_sources.limits: Very small male sample, possible carryover, failure-based performance protocol differs from RIR envelope; its loading protocol is not adopted.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-AUTOREG-SR favors autoregulation overall; heterogeneity prevents treating one as universal refutation.
evidence_sources.confidence: LOW-MODERATE as counterexample to universal superiority

evidence_sources.title: Effects of tapering on performance in endurance athletes
evidence_sources.access: Indexed abstract and PMC limitation extracts
evidence_sources.population: Competitive athletes across endurance and some sprint contexts
evidence_sources.observed: Time-trial/time-to-exhaustion improved in pooled analyses; maximal oxygen uptake/economy did not show improvement.
evidence_sources.limits: Pre/post analyses, subgroups, event heterogeneity and sprint inclusion limit transfer; reported percentage/duration suggestions are not a validated individual recipe.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: EV-TAPER-COUNTER has no significant performance improvement; lack of significance in tiny study is not proof of no benefit.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for context-dependent strategy; LOW for exact app dose

evidence_sources.title: Physiological responses to a 6-d taper in middle-distance runners
evidence_sources.design: Random assignment to two taper protocols after training
evidence_sources.population: Eight well-trained male middle-distance runners; four per arm; 800-m outcome
evidence_sources.observed: Neither taper showed statistically significant performance improvement.
evidence_sources.limits: Tiny sample, no non-taper comparator, short event/protocol; cannot prove taper ineffective or extrapolate to distance race.
evidence_sources.confidence: LOW for general effect, useful against guaranteed benefit

evidence_sources.title: 2016 Consensus statement on return to sport from the First World Congress in Sports Physical Therapy, Bern
evidence_sources.design: Consensus process with 17 expert clinicians; synthesis and group deliberation
evidence_sources.population: Return-to-sport decision context after injury; no trial sample for app policy
evidence_sources.observed: Return is multifactorial risk management shared by clinicians, athletes and coaches, not isolated final clearance event.
evidence_sources.limits: Consensus is not validation of product triage, urgency copy or medical algorithm; condition-specific review still needed.
evidence_sources.counterevidence: No policy-level validation data for Vilumo identified; clinical and nonclinical return must remain distinct.
evidence_sources.confidence: MODERATE for authority/process boundary; no clinical validation

claims.scope: Documentary arbitration, not individual causal prediction
claims.decision: PC-INTERFERENCE requires endpoint/task/horizon and applicable rule
claims.gap: G02 individual applicability and sufficient-change assessment

claims.text: Order and spacing of doubles are conditional on endpoint, preference and admissible horizon
claims.decision: No universal order or spacing cutoff; C2 remains domain-conditional
claims.gap: G01/G02 double eligibility, payload and next-stimulus approval

claims.text: HRV interpretation requires a specified individual-reference measurement/decision method
claims.decision: No isolated nightly veto or blanket HRV irrelevance

claims.text: Recovery signals represent different uncertain constructs; simulated debt is not measured physiology
claims.decision: PC-SIGNALS/PC-EXPOSURE preserve vector, provenance and uncertainty

claims.text: Already accepted autoregulated selection is execution; changing its envelope is mutation

claims.text: Taper must be event/priority/phase/population specific and cannot promise benefit
claims.decision: PC-TAPER no numeric universal recipe; validate cancelled/postponed variants

claims.text: Return after clinical restriction needs competent assessment and accepted evidence, not an app score or click
claims.scope: PDR G04/AEOS HOLD; consensus corroborates process boundary
claims.confidence: HIGH for authority; clinical rule not approved
claims.gap: G04 actual classes, responsible professionals, exit/re-evaluation cases

claims.text: Adherence, completed dose, intended stimulus and earned progression are distinct conclusions
claims.scope: Raw event/correction and future evaluation semantics

rule_submission_schema.promotion_rule: DOMAIN_APPROVED requires real scoped approval evidence and exact-version cases; a synthetic fixture passing or literature citation cannot promote itself.

excluded_or_limited_sources.disposition: IDENTITY_RECHECKED_ONLY; no abstract available, publisher inaccessible; prior r3 evidence retained as history
Consulted for counterevidence; overlapping intervention corpus not counted as independent replication or added sample

excluded_or_limited_sources.ref: Secondary blogs, narrative reviews and unrelated search hits

limits: No observed Vilumo runtime or athlete outcomes; no clinical validation or expert-parity claim.
Literature access was bounded, often indexed abstracts; systematic-review titles do not make this project search a systematic review.
Primary studies may be included in cited meta-analyses; evidence is not independent by URL count.
Group effects and subgroup time windows are not individual thresholds, safety guarantees or approved recipes.
No universal dose, percentage, duration, HRV cutoff, return interval, adherence tolerance or progression increment authored.
No real professional approval evidence in inspected inputs; absence not proof of nonexistence elsewhere.
G09/G11 triggers remain existing separate requirements; not closed by this documentary research.

experiment_guardrails.allowed_scope: Local documentary/control and explicitly synthetic fixture evaluation only
experiment_guardrails.reversibility: Versioned local draft; no athlete-facing execution or real plan mutation
measurement: Independent fidelity review against unchanged r3 rubric
stop: Attempted real prescription/export from synthetic assumptions
Missing critical rule or changed authority
experiment_guardrails.owner: Mission owner; qualified reviewers before dependent prescription work
experiment_guardrails.research_stop_reason: Additional general literature would not supply real approval or approved case payloads; targeted sources suffice to bound permissible contract and show material counterevidence.

next_action: Independent review of exact artifact revisions; consume clauses with synthetic/domain distinction; obtain scoped real G01-G04 approval evidence before dependent prescriptive implementation.
